title: Pure Gunkan
summary: Gunkan cards only, with generic Rank 4s, Links and staples. Every Gunkan Xyz Monster gets extra effects depending on which Gunkan Suship monsters it was made from, and with Gunkan Suship Shari as material it draws a card. The toppings summon themselves next to Shari. Ikura excavates for Shari, Shirauo summons another Gunkan and stacks Shari on top of the Deck, and Uni reveals a Gunkan to summon itself and searches Shari. Gunkan Suship Shari Red counts as Shari everywhere and summons a Gunkan from the Deck. Gunkan Suship Catch-of-the-Day, the newest card, reveals Shari and an Xyz to make the opponent name a topping, which you then search. Shirauo-class Carrier searches a Gunkan Spell/Trap, and Uni-class Super-Dreadnought attacks directly.
